Laravel library package `pepperfm/api-responder-for-laravel`; active branch `3.x`. Not a Laravel application. Classes are in `Pepperfm\ApiBaseResponder` under `src/`.

Commands:
vendor/bin/pest --filter="test name"
vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit/ApiBaseResponderTest.php
composer lint-hard

Every PHP file requires `declare(strict_types=1)` (enforced by Pint). Use Laravel Pint preset/custom rules in `pint.json`: class/function braces next line; control-structure braces same line; `fn()` spacing; no import ordering; `not_operator_with_successor_space`: false (`!$var`); `phpdoc_to_property_type` and `phpdoc_to_return_type` enabled (prefer native types).

Direct API: `ApiBaseResponder::response()`, `stored()`, `deleted()` resolve keys via config/private `buildJsonResponse()`. No `debug_backtrace()`.

Builder API: `build()` creates blank builder; `forMethod('show')` sets REST context; `withDataKey('users')` sets explicit key; `fromAction()` reads calling-method PHP attributes via opt-in minimal backtrace. `ResponseBuilder` data-key priority: explicit `withDataKey()` > `#[ResponseDataKey]` via `fromAction()` > REST convention (`show`/`update` singular, others plural) > `laravel-api-responder.plural_data_key`. `paginated()` delegates to `MetaResolver::resolve()` for `LengthAwarePaginator`/`CursorPaginator` data and pagination meta, then calls `response()`.
